sections.title: Learning loop (report 16.1 row 10, DEC-28, DEC-29; docs/learning.md)
comment: Report conformance, the Docs Delta gate and the retro/gaps/calibration commands. Nothing here edits a rule, primer, agent or setting: `loopctl gaps`
writes drafts under the git directory and prints the commands a human runs (H6). Read from the BASE sha, never from the branch under judgement (CO-11).

keys.name: report_trailers
doc: warn | block   (report 16.1 row 10, L-32, DEC-29). How strictly the driver reads an engineer's report and its JSON trailer. `block` fails the item on
every form problem (a missing trailer, a missing section, NONE without a checked: line); `warn` fails it only when the decision cannot be read or the
trailer contradicts the report, and records the rest as report_warning events. A forged trailer is never tolerated in either mode. Move to `block` once
`loopctl report scan` shows a clean streak. Not evidence-gated: `block` is the stricter of the two.
warn first; block when `loopctl report scan` says the streak is clean

keys.name: docs_delta_min_words
doc: Docs Delta gate (gates.docs): the fewest net-new words a change to documentation files must add before it counts as documenting anything. A blank
line, trailing whitespace, a reflow or a punctuation-only edit adds none. Lowering it weakens the gate, so it is H6.

keys.name: gaps_min_occurrences
doc: `loopctl gaps` drafts a rule or primer change only for a gap seen in at least this many items or reports of the milestone (one odd report is not a pattern).

keys.name: calibration_min_samples
doc: `loopctl calibration report` judges a critic's precision only after this many logged blockers with a final outcome; before that it says `pending`.

keys.name: harness_min_item_runs
doc: `loopctl harness` names a gate a removal candidate only after it has run on at least this many items without once blocking or catching anything.
